tools.name: execute_spark
tools.description: Execute PySpark code on AWS Lambda for data processing, analysis, and visualization. Supports DataFrame operations, SQL queries, data transformations, and chart generation.

code.description: PySpark code to execute. The code should write results to /tmp/output.json as a JSON object. Example: spark.createDataFrame([...]).toPandas().to_json('/tmp/output.json')

dataset_name.description: Optional. Name(s) of dataset(s) used in the code. Can be a single string or array of strings.

bucket.description: Optional. S3 bucket name for storing outputs and accessing datasets.

file_path.description: Optional. S3 key prefix (folder path) for storing outputs.

config.description: Optional. Additional Spark configuration parameters as key-value pairs.
